      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the requirements of paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.",

        "statement": "In conjunction with the development of the State plan as required under subsection (b), the lead agency shall hold at least one hearing in the State with sufficient time and statewide distribution of notice of such hearing, to provide to the public an opportunity to comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds to be provided through the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the period covered by the State plan.",

      "unit": "F011",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, the State shall hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with the development of the State plan.",
        "actor": "the State",
        "actor_quote": "the State",
        "kind": "requirement",

      }

    {
      "unit": "F013",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan covering a period of not less than 1 fiscal year and not more than 2 fiscal years; the plan shall be submitted not later than 30 days prior to the beginning of the first fiscal year covered by the plan, and shall contain such information as the Secretary shall require, including the assurances and information specified in paragraphs (1) through (13).",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "scope_quotes": ["F013"],
        "context_quotes": null,

        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F013:F024",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that funds made available through the grant or allotment will be used to support activities designed to assist low-income families and individuals (including families and individuals receiving assistance under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act, homeless families and individuals, migrant or seasonal farmworkers, and elderly low-income individuals and families), and a description of how such activities will enable families and individuals: (i) to remove obstacles and solve problems blocking self-sufficiency (including for those transitioning off part A of title IV assistance); (ii) to secure and retain meaningful employment; (iii) to attain an adequate education, with particular attention toward improving literacy skills in the communities involved (which may include family literacy initiatives); (iv) to make better use of available income; (v) to obtain and maintain adequate housing and a suitable living environment; (vi) to obtain emergency assistance through loans, grants, or other means for immediate and urgent needs; and (vii) to achieve greater community participation, including grassroots partnerships with local law enforcement, housing authorities, private foundations, and other partners to document best practices for urban replication and strengthen relationships with local law enforcement (which may include neighborhood or community policing efforts).",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "scope_quotes": ["F013"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9905", "section 9906", "part A of title IV of the Social Security Act"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F013:F028",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that funds made available through the grant or allotment will be used to address the needs of youth in low-income communities through youth development programs that support the primary role of the family, give priority to preventing youth problems and crime, promote community coordination and collaboration, and support the development and expansion of innovative community-based youth development programs demonstrating success in preventing or reducing youth crime, such as violence-free zone programs involving youth development and intervention models (e.g., youth mediation, mentoring, life skills training, job creation, and entrepreneurship programs) and after-school child care programs.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "scope_quotes": ["F013"],

    {
      "unit": "F013:F029",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that funds made available through the grant or allotment will be used to make more effective use of, and coordinate with, other programs related to the purposes of this chapter (including State welfare reform efforts).",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",

    {
      "unit": "F013:F031",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain a description of how the State intends to use discretionary funds made available from the remainder of the grant or allotment described in section 9907(b) of this title in accordance with this chapter, including a description of how the State will support innovative community and neighborhood-based initiatives related to the purposes of this chapter.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",

    {
      "unit": "F013:F036",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain information provided by eligible entities in the State, containing: (A) a description of the service delivery system for services provided or coordinated with funds from grants made under section 9907(a) targeted to low-income individuals and families; (B) a description of how linkages will be developed to fill identified service gaps via information, referrals, case management, and followup consultations; (C) a description of how funds from section 9907(a) grants will be coordinated with other public and private resources; and (D) a description of how the local entity will use the funds to support innovative community and neighborhood-based initiatives related to the purposes of this chapter (which may include fatherhood initiatives and other family-strengthening and parenting initiatives).",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",

    {
      "unit": "F013:F038",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that eligible entities in the State will provide, on an emergency basis, for the provision of such supplies and services, nutritious foods, and related services, as may be necessary to counteract conditions of starvation and malnutrition among low-income individuals.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",

    {
      "unit": "F013:F039",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State and eligible entities in the State will coordinate and establish linkages between governmental and other social services programs to assure effective delivery and avoid duplication, and a description of how the State and eligible entities will coordinate the provision of employment and training activities (as defined in section 3 of the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act) in the State and communities with entities providing activities through statewide and local workforce development systems under that Act.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",

        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F013:F040",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State will ensure coordination between antipoverty programs in each community in the State, and ensure, where appropriate, that emergency energy crisis intervention programs under title XXVI (relating to low-income home energy assistance) are conducted in such community.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",

      }
    },
    {

      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State will permit and cooperate with Federal investigations undertaken in accordance with section 9916 of this title.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",

    {
      "unit": "F013:F042",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["cause_funding_reduction", "cause_termination"],
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that any eligible entity in the State that received funding in the previous fiscal year through a community services block grant made under this chapter will not have its funding terminated under this chapter, or reduced below the proportional share of funding it received in the previous fiscal year unless, after providing notice and an opportunity for a hearing on the record, the State determines that cause exists for such termination or reduction, subject to review by the Secretary as provided in section 9915(b) of this title.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",

      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State and eligible entities in the State will, to the maximum extent possible, coordinate programs with and form partnerships with other organizations serving low-income residents of the communities and members of the groups served by the State, including religious organizations, charitable groups, and community organizations.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",

    {

      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State will require each eligible entity in the State to establish procedures under which a low-income individual, community organization, or religious organization, or representative of low-income individuals that considers its organization, or low-income individuals, to be inadequately represented on the board (or other mechanism) of the eligible entity may petition for adequate representation.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",

    {
      "unit": "F013:F045",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State will secure from each eligible entity in the State, as a condition to receipt of funding by the entity through a community services block grant under this chapter for a program, a community action plan (which shall be submitted to the Secretary, at the request of the Secretary, with the State plan) that includes a community-needs assessment for the community served, which may be coordinated with community-needs assessments conducted for other programs.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",

    {
      "unit": "F013:F046",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State and all eligible entities in the State will, not later than fiscal year 2001, participate in the Results Oriented Management and Accountability System, another performance measure system for which the Secretary facilitated development pursuant to section 9917(b) of this title, or an alternative system for measuring performance and results meeting the requirements of that section, and a description of outcome measures to be used to measure eligible entity performance in promoting self-sufficiency, family stability, and community revitalization.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",

        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain information describing how the State will carry out the assurances described in subsection (b).",

    {
      "unit": "F049:F055",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "cause_funding_reduction",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a funding reduction, the term “cause” includes: (A) a statewide redistribution of funds provided through a community services block grant under this chapter to respond to (i) the results of the most recently available census or other appropriate data, (ii) the designation of a new eligible entity, or (iii) severe economic dislocation; or (B) the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",

        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a termination, the term “cause” includes the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.",

unit_attributes.statement: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the requirements of paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.
unit_attributes.actor: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title
unit_attributes.actor_quote: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: The lead agency shall develop the State plan to be submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b).

In conjunction with the development of the State plan as required under subsection (b), the lead agency shall hold at least one hearing in the State with sufficient time and statewide distribution of notice of such hearing, to provide to the public an opportunity to comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds to be provided through the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the period covered by the State plan.
The lead agency shall conduct reviews of eligible entities under section 9914 of this title.

In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, the State shall hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with the development of the State plan.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan covering a period of not less than 1 fiscal year and not more than 2 fiscal years; the plan shall be submitted not later than 30 days prior to the beginning of the first fiscal year covered by the plan, and shall contain such information as the Secretary shall require, including the assurances and information specified in paragraphs (1) through (13).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that funds made available through the grant or allotment will be used to support activities designed to assist low-income families and individuals (including families and individuals receiving assistance under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act, homeless families and individuals, migrant or seasonal farmworkers, and elderly low-income individuals and families), and a description of how such activities will enable families and individuals: (i) to remove obstacles and solve problems blocking self-sufficiency (including for those transitioning off part A of title IV assistance); (ii) to secure and retain meaningful employment; (iii) to attain an adequate education, with particular attention toward improving literacy skills in the communities involved (which may include family literacy initiatives); (iv) to make better use of available income; (v) to obtain and maintain adequate housing and a suitable living environment; (vi) to obtain emergency assistance through loans, grants, or other means for immediate and urgent needs; and (vii) to achieve greater community participation, including grassroots partnerships with local law enforcement, housing authorities, private foundations, and other partners to document best practices for urban replication and strengthen relationships with local law enforcement (which may include neighborhood or community policing efforts).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title
references: part A of title IV of the Social Security Act

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that funds made available through the grant or allotment will be used to address the needs of youth in low-income communities through youth development programs that support the primary role of the family, give priority to preventing youth problems and crime, promote community coordination and collaboration, and support the development and expansion of innovative community-based youth development programs demonstrating success in preventing or reducing youth crime, such as violence-free zone programs involving youth development and intervention models (e.g., youth mediation, mentoring, life skills training, job creation, and entrepreneurship programs) and after-school child care programs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that funds made available through the grant or allotment will be used to make more effective use of, and coordinate with, other programs related to the purposes of this chapter (including State welfare reform efforts).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain a description of how the State intends to use discretionary funds made available from the remainder of the grant or allotment described in section 9907(b) of this title in accordance with this chapter, including a description of how the State will support innovative community and neighborhood-based initiatives related to the purposes of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain information provided by eligible entities in the State, containing: (A) a description of the service delivery system for services provided or coordinated with funds from grants made under section 9907(a) targeted to low-income individuals and families; (B) a description of how linkages will be developed to fill identified service gaps via information, referrals, case management, and followup consultations; (C) a description of how funds from section 9907(a) grants will be coordinated with other public and private resources; and (D) a description of how the local entity will use the funds to support innovative community and neighborhood-based initiatives related to the purposes of this chapter (which may include fatherhood initiatives and other family-strengthening and parenting initiatives).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that eligible entities in the State will provide, on an emergency basis, for the provision of such supplies and services, nutritious foods, and related services, as may be necessary to counteract conditions of starvation and malnutrition among low-income individuals.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State and eligible entities in the State will coordinate and establish linkages between governmental and other social services programs to assure effective delivery and avoid duplication, and a description of how the State and eligible entities will coordinate the provision of employment and training activities (as defined in section 3 of the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act) in the State and communities with entities providing activities through statewide and local workforce development systems under that Act.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title
references: section 3 of the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State will ensure coordination between antipoverty programs in each community in the State, and ensure, where appropriate, that emergency energy crisis intervention programs under title XXVI (relating to low-income home energy assistance) are conducted in such community.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State will permit and cooperate with Federal investigations undertaken in accordance with section 9916 of this title.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that any eligible entity in the State that received funding in the previous fiscal year through a community services block grant made under this chapter will not have its funding terminated under this chapter, or reduced below the proportional share of funding it received in the previous fiscal year unless, after providing notice and an opportunity for a hearing on the record, the State determines that cause exists for such termination or reduction, subject to review by the Secretary as provided in section 9915(b) of this title.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State and eligible entities in the State will, to the maximum extent possible, coordinate programs with and form partnerships with other organizations serving low-income residents of the communities and members of the groups served by the State, including religious organizations, charitable groups, and community organizations.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State will require each eligible entity in the State to establish procedures under which a low-income individual, community organization, or religious organization, or representative of low-income individuals that considers its organization, or low-income individuals, to be inadequately represented on the board (or other mechanism) of the eligible entity may petition for adequate representation.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State will secure from each eligible entity in the State, as a condition to receipt of funding by the entity through a community services block grant under this chapter for a program, a community action plan (which shall be submitted to the Secretary, at the request of the Secretary, with the State plan) that includes a community-needs assessment for the community served, which may be coordinated with community-needs assessments conducted for other programs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain an assurance that the State and all eligible entities in the State will, not later than fiscal year 2001, participate in the Results Oriented Management and Accountability System, another performance measure system for which the Secretary facilitated development pursuant to section 9917(b) of this title, or an alternative system for measuring performance and results meeting the requirements of that section, and a description of outcome measures to be used to measure eligible entity performance in promoting self-sufficiency, family stability, and community revitalization.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, the State's application and plan submitted to be eligible for a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title must contain information describing how the State will carry out the assurances described in subsection (b).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a funding reduction, the term “cause” includes: (A) a statewide redistribution of funds provided through a community services block grant under this chapter to respond to (i) the results of the most recently available census or other appropriate data, (ii) the designation of a new eligible entity, or (iii) severe economic dislocation; or (B) the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a funding reduction

unit_attributes.statement: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a termination, the term “cause” includes the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a termination

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary may prescribe procedures for the purpose of assessing the effectiveness of eligible entities in carrying out the purposes of this chapter.
The chief executive officer of each State may revise any plan prepared under section 9908.

unit_attributes.actor_quote: The chief executive officer of each State

unit_attributes.statement: If the chief executive officer of a State revises any plan prepared under section 9908, they shall submit the revised plan to the Secretary.

unit_attributes.statement: Each plan or revised plan prepared under section 9908 shall be made available for public inspection within the State in such a manner as will facilitate review of, and comment on, the plan.

For fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan in accordance with the provisions of this chapter (as in effect on the day before October 27, 1998), rather than the provisions of subsections (a) through (c) relating to applications and plans.
